answers.text: REFUSE: A cell's grey fill is direct formatting, which can't be set here, and no existing style has the #D9D9D9 fill.
REFUSE: Those headings are plain paragraphs in the default style. Dark red 18pt would need a new style or direct text formatting, and neither can be created here.
REFUSE: The header cells need a #D9D9D9 fill, which is direct cell formatting and can't be set here. No existing style has that fill.

REFUSE: The paragraphs beginning with □ are in the default style, which all other paragraphs share. A first-line indent for only those would need a new style or direct paragraph formatting, and neither can be created here.
